Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.onchain

Interface KfeOnchainPaymentGateway

All Known Implementing Classes:
KfeOnchainCustodyAdapter
public interface KfeOnchainPaymentGateway
Contract for on-chain payment providers, including optional preflight and durable preparation hooks. Implementations that cannot safely prepare before broadcast retain the explicit unsupported defaults.

    • prepareOnchain

      default KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.PreparedOnchainPayment prepareOnchain(KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.OnchainPaymentCommand command)
      Durably prepares a transaction before broadcast when the provider supports two-phase execution.
      Parameters:

    • broadcastPrepared

      default KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.PaymentResult broadcastPrepared(KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.PreparedOnchainPayment prepared)

    • releasePrepared

      default void releasePrepared(KfeOnchainPaymentGateway.PreparedOnchainPayment prepared)
      Releases provider-side resources held during preparation when execution is abandoned. Implementations without external prepare locks may leave the default no-op in place.
      Parameters:
      prepared - prepared payment whose external reservation should be released
